Fast to learn. Different every round.

How the game begins

Critical Split is a quick strategy game where the characters you receive shape the risks you take. Some hit hard. Some manipulate the dice. Some become stronger with the right partner.

01

Make the Divine Split

Shuffle six character cards face down. Choose two characters and take their matching dice.

02

Roll your pair

Roll both dice together, then use your characters’ abilities to build the strongest final score.

03

Claim the gems

Win the round and take a gem. The first player to collect three gems wins the game.
